Update the labels on a resource

Usage: slipway label [OPTIONS] (<TYPE> <NAME> | <TYPE/NAME>) [KEY=VALUE|KEY-]...

Arguments:
  <TYPE>               The resource type, by its plural, singular or short name (see api-resources)
  [NAME]               The name of a resource of that type
  [KEY=VALUE|KEY-]...  A label to set, as KEY=VALUE, or to remove, as KEY-

Options:
      --overwrite  Allow labels to be overwritten
      --list       If true, display the labels for a given resource instead of writing them
      --dry-run    Print what would change and write nothing
  -h, --help       Print help (see more with '--help')

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
